explanation: The theorem states additivity of the library-specific definition `PlaceSpecialization.depthDiv`. That definition is `D.sum fun V n => Finsupp.single (P.reduceFst V) (n * depth V)`. The content lies in this definition and in `P.reduceFst`. The proof is a direct application of `Finsupp.sum_add_index'` to this definition. I found no Mathlib declaration that states additivity of this specific map, so I did not search Mathlib further. `Finsupp.sum_add_index'` is only the ingredient the proof uses. It does not state the theorem.
